description: Fáze 15: the preview legend — a collapsible card explaining the notation shapes (stencil icons + localized type labels) the generated document actually uses, grouped into Elements and Relationships. The host supplies the entries (the shared ModelingNotationCatalog, filtered to the document); the card is presentational. Accessible: list semantics, decorative icons (aria-hidden) next to visible text, an aria-expanded/aria-controls collapse toggle (Collapsible, off in the mobile sheet). Positioned by the preview's stylesheet as an overlay card in the canvas's top-right corner — it never participates in the canvas column's flow (the canvas keeps its height) and never covers the status bar's zoom group.

parameters.name: Collapsible
parameters.description: Whether the card renders its collapse toggle. Default true. The mobile legend sheet passes false: a bottom sheet cannot collapse its own content, and a toggle that does nothing would be an unusable control.

parameters.name: DefaultExpanded
parameters.description: Whether the card starts expanded. The hosting editor passes the layout rule (desktop expanded, tablet collapsed — and collapsed above the editor's 12-node rule). Seeded ONCE — the user's own toggle owns the state afterwards.

parameters.name: Entries
parameters.description: The legend entries (already filtered to the types present in the document). Null renders nothing — the host decided the legend has no data.
